import hashlib
import json
import os
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

source = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
destination = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
raw = b'{"version":7,"observed_at":120.0,"aircraft":[{"aircraft_id":"EAST","x_nm":-8.0,"y_nm":1.0,"altitude_ft":12000.0,"vx_nm_min":2.0,"vy_nm_min":0.0,"climb_ft_min":0.0},{"aircraft_id":"WEST","x_nm":8.0,"y_nm":1.0,"altitude_ft":12000.0,"vx_nm_min":-2.0,"vy_nm_min":0.0,"climb_ft_min":0.0}]}\n'
env = {**os.environ, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1"}
results = {}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="file-witness-", dir=destination.parent) as directory:
    root = pathlib.Path(directory)
    world = root / "world Ω.json"
    world.write_bytes(raw)
    regular_link = root / "world-link.json"
    regular_link.symlink_to(world.name)
    fifo = root / "waiting.fifo"
    os.mkfifo(fifo)
    fifo_link = root / "fifo-link"
    fifo_link.symlink_to(fifo.name)
    oversized = root / "oversized.json"
    with oversized.open("wb") as output:
        output.write(raw)
        output.truncate(262145)
    cases = {
        "regular": ([str(world)], None),
        "regular_symlink": ([str(regular_link)], None),
        "stdin": (["-"], raw),
        "malformed": (["-"], b"{broken}"),
        "native_stale": ([str(world), "--now", "131"], None),
        "oversized": ([str(oversized)], None),
        "directory": ([str(root)], None),
        "fifo": ([str(fifo)], None),
        "fifo_symlink": ([str(fifo_link)], None),
        "character_device": (["/dev/null"], None),
    }
    for label, (arguments, input_bytes) in cases.items():
        command = [sys.executable, "-B", str(source / "plan_world.py"), *arguments]
        try:
            process = subprocess.run(command, input=input_bytes, capture_output=True,
                                     timeout=2, check=False, env=env, cwd=root)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
            results[label] = {"outcome": "timeout", "limit_seconds": 2,
                              "stdout": (error.stdout or b"").decode(),
                              "stderr": (error.stderr or b"").decode()}
        else:
            results[label] = {"outcome": "completed", "returncode": process.returncode,
                              "stdout_bytes": len(process.stdout),
                              "stdout_sha256": hashlib.sha256(process.stdout).hexdigest(),
                              "stderr": process.stderr.decode()}
            if process.returncode == 0:
                report = json.loads(process.stdout)
                results[label].update({"status": report["status"],
                                       "candidate_count": report["candidate_count"],
                                       "advisory_count": len(report["advisories"]),
                                       "input_sha256": report["input_sha256"]})
    assert world.read_bytes() == raw
    results["input_unchanged"] = True
receipt = {"source": str(source), "python": sys.version,
           "source_sha256": {name: hashlib.sha256((source / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                             for name in ("plan_world.py", "towerops.py", "advisory_options.py")},
           "results": results}
destination.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2))
